question: First serve: in 60%, wins 75% when in. Second serve: in 90%, wins 45% when in. Points per 100 gained by hitting two first serves?
move: Weigh how often a risk fails against how much it pays when it works.
ask: Which safe option am I choosing only because its failures feel more embarrassing?
trap: Fearing the extra double faults more than valuing the stronger serve.
hint: Multiply the chance the serve lands by the chance of winning once it does.
reference: Franc Klaassen & Jan R. Magnus, Analyzing Wimbledon: The Power of Statistics, Oxford University Press, 2014
